label: Grounding well-founded on actual concreta, from the esse regress and ground-cause bridge
description: Converse inclusion, non-transcription conditional derivation on one m, w and p. If there is no infinite regress of actual causes of being (fd12ad3d), an actual concrete ground of an actual concretum at w is distinct from it and a cause of its esse (98efaa9e) and whatever exists at w is in act of esse (0436de86), then grounding among actual concreta at w is well-founded (82cfaf26). Step: a grounding edge between actual concreta is, by 98efaa9e and 0436de86, an ActualEsseCause edge between the same beings. Diagnostic purpose: with esseRegressOfActualGroundingWF, under all five bridges (cb1cdea9, 546975ef, 2d9807a5 forward; 98efaa9e, 0436de86 backward) the two relations are coextensive (lake-checked law actualEsseCause_iff_actualGround: an actual cause of being is exactly a grounding step between actual concreta), so 82cfaf26 and fd12ad3d are interderivable: on that package they are one assumption presented over two relations, the package's warrant is warrant for an extensional identification made through explicit open premises, and supporting one does not add independent evidence for the other. Without the backward bridge they come apart: the last conjunct of converseControls is a Bool interpretation in which grounding among actual concreta is a two-cycle while the forward bridges, the esse regress, irreflexivity, the priority bridge and well-founded priority hold, all vacuously because causes of being and simple priority are the empty relation there. The other conjuncts give, for each of the three inputs, an interpretation in which the other two hold and 82cfaf26 fails, and a nonvacuous interpretation. Facts about these interpretations only. This argument closes a support cycle with esseRegressOfActualGroundingWF; the cycle adds no warrant by itself.
